SELECT id,code,approve_status, seller_name, approve_user_name, name,short_name,disabled, use_org_name,group_id,group_name, create_user_name,create_time, ci.platform_type as platformType FROM customer_info ci WHERE

select id,"name", code,group_id,group_name from customer_info ci where ci.is_deleted = FALSE and group_id != '' ORDER BY group_name

SELECT ci.id, ci.code, ci.name, ca.address AS receiveAddress, ca.person AS receiverName, ca.tel_number AS telNumber FROM customer_info ci LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON ci.id = ca.main_id AND ca.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ci.is_deleted = FALSE
AND ci.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}::text, '%')
ORDER BY ca.is_default desc limit 1
